names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's life of the four for 12 noiembrie; the day page's line prints him as «Vasile din Telciu».

death.note: doxologia.ro: «au suferit martiriul în ziua de 12 noiembrie 1763», and the page says he was hanged at Salva that day for the same fault as Atanasie Todoran. No year of birth is printed.
